tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and low specific gravity are noted. No casts or ketones detected. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of antibiotic therapy based on sensitivity testing.
